quotes.text: Support link should not accumulate duplicate utm_content params

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: setCurrentSubview rebuilds the Support anchor URL from formatted app.support.baseURL and sets account-hub source/referral parameters plus the current subview. Email and address-book footer setup pass their current state. The direct widget test checks the base URL and replacement of utm_content without duplicates; it does not verify an external browser launch or analytics delivery.
title: Account Hub Support links rebuild their query from the current subview
